title: A manifest carrying an excerpt of read content is rejected
rationale: Placed inside metadata rather than at the top level, because a nested block is where an implementation would most plausibly leak one by accident. Every object in the manifest schema closes itself, so the rejection is reported at /metadata rather than at the root.

requirement.text: Content excerpts, quotations, or content hashes of read material.
